title: audit-log-exporter: wire retention and export sinks into private installer (Helm + Terraform)
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: This PR wires the audit-log-exporter into the Private installer flow so that retention policies and export sinks are configurable via both Helm values and Terraform modules. Motivation: customers deploying Redwood Private must have an opinionated, auditable pipeline for forwarding audit events to long-term stores (S3/GCS) and SIEMs, and must be able to configure retention windows as part of automated installs and upgrades. Changes include: Helm chart additions for audit-exporter subchart and values schema, Terraform module outputs/inputs to expose sink configuration and retention TTLs, installer templates that stitch audit-exporter values into the private control plane, migration logic to apply default retention policies on upgrade, and tests + docs. This is intended to be fully backward-compatible with existing installer flows; defaults preserve current behavior unless the operator opts into retention/export sinks. See linked Linear ENG-3421 for design notes and rollout plan.
commits: init: add helm subchart for audit-log-exporter with default values and templates
terraform: add audit_exporter module, inputs for sinks and retention_ttl, outputs for installer wiring
installer: merge audit-exporter helm values into private installer templates and add default migration job
tests: add helm chart unit tests and terraform plan unit for new module
docs: add installer guide for configuring sinks and retention in Private

release_notes: Adds audit-log-exporter wiring to Private installer. Operators can now configure audit export sinks (S3/GCS/SIEM) and retention TTL via Helm values or Terraform module inputs. Includes an idempotent migration that applies default retention policies during upgrade. Backward-compatible defaults preserved.
